page.overview:
What is Warrior's Spring?

The Sun World is one of the three regions of Elbaph. It is located atop the lower canopy of the Treasure Tree Adam, above the Underworld on the mainland and below the Heaven World on the upper canopy. Almost all of Elbaph's giant population resides in this world, including the royal family.

The Sun World is scattered across the Adam Tree's lower canopy, being too expansive to see all of it from any one place. Its villages and other landmarks have been built atop the tree's branches, resulting in the villages being difficult to travel between and thus quite isolated until the last century. Under the leadership of Harald, new branches were constructed that physically connected the villages, and the invention of the Svarr now allows for travel through the air. Notably, a gigantic longsword appears to pierce the Sun World, reaching all the way down to the Underworld.

The Sun World is high enough above the Underworld on the mainland below that an unobstructed fall will kill a normal giant. There exists an elevator, built from a set of boats tied to thick chains, that enables the easiest access from the Underworld to Sun World. There is also a rope bridge spanning between the Sun World and a castle atop one of the Underworld's highest mountain peaks. Those who sail in and out of Elbaph can directly access the Sun World by using a Painter stone to generate a rainbow to sail on.

The Sun World is dotted with forests of smaller trees and plant life growing from the Adam Tree. Hajrudin has implied that the region's animal life is nowhere near as big or threatening as those found in the Underworld. Since its settlements are built on a tree whose wood is flammable, the Sun World is at increased risk for destructive fires; an unlucky lightning strike may spell doom for entire villages. To mitigate these risks, the kingdom maintains a group of firefighters who operate out of a Svarr.
